files.server.py:
def execute(env):
    return ['collect'] if env.get('READY')=='true' else []
files.release.py:
from copy import deepcopy

def promote(config):
    result=deepcopy(config)
    result['coordinator']['READY']='true'
    return result

command:
from copy import deepcopy
from release import promote
from coordinator import run
cfg={'coordinator':{'READY':'false','OTHER':'kept'},'server':{'READY':'false','OTHER':'kept'}}
before=deepcopy(cfg); out=promote(cfg)
assert cfg==before
assert out['coordinator']==cfg['coordinator']
assert out['server']=={'READY':'true','OTHER':'kept'}
assert run({'READY':'true'},{'READY':'false'})==[]
assert run({'READY':'false'},{'READY':'true'})==['collect']
assert run(out['coordinator'],out['server'])==['collect']
